# Speech-MCP

> FastMCP 3.2 multi-provider speech gateway: **FunASR local STT (default)**, Gemini Live/TTS, Hume, ElevenLabs, wake word, RAG, fleet voice command bus.

## Core documentation

- [Humanoid voice — thesis & architecture](docs/HUMANOID_VOICE.md) — embodied agents, Chinese open speech, fleet bus
- [FunASR local STT (full guide)](docs/providers/funasr.md) — default STT, env, sidecar, MCP tools, benchmarks
- [Chinese FOSS speech landscape](docs/CHINESE_AI_RESEARCH.md) — FunASR, SenseVoice, CosyVoice, ChatTTS, GPT-SoVITS, others
- [Tools reference](docs/tools-reference.md) — transcribe_audio_file, transcribe_stream_chunk, TTS, RAG
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md) — FUNASR_* and provider env vars
- [Installation](INSTALL.md) — uv sync --extra funasr, just bootstrap
- [Voice command bus](docs/VOICE_COMMAND_BUS.md) — wake → FunASR → fleet-agent
- [Agentic orchestration](docs/AGENTIC_ORCHESTRATION.md) — FastMCP sampling, dialogic returns
- [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)

## STT (FunASR)

- MCP: `transcribe_audio_file`, `transcribe_stream_chunk` (default provider `funasr`)
- REST: `POST /api/v1/transcribe?provider=funasr`
- Enable: `FUNASR_ENABLED=true` + `uv sync --extra funasr`, or `FUNASR_OPENAI_URL` sidecar on 10910

## Features

- FunASR: VAD + ASR + punctuation + diarization; SenseVoice emotion tags
- Cloud TTS/live: Gemini, Hume, ElevenLabs; Windows SAPI5 fallback
- Wake word (openWakeWord); fleet voice delegate to fleet-agent
- RAG: LanceDB + `search_docs` / `ask_docs`
- Dialogic tool returns; SEP-1577 sampling via `ctx.sample()`
